messages:
incident-bot: detected SAS token pattern in CI logs for container 'ci-artifacts-prod' (rw-infer-logs). Flagged as potential credential leak.
maya: thanks, opening thread. which job printed this?
jonathan: looks like `deploy-artifacts` pipeline printed the full SAS URL during error path.
vijay: checking network posture of the uploader VM `prod-logging-vm`.
sec-bot: anomaly: NSG `nsg-prod-logging` has rule id `r-9080-any` allowing 0.0.0.0/0 -> 9080 created by `terraform-ci` 14h ago.
kira: SOC is watching outbound connections. we've seen egress to 13.54.11.77:9080 and 34.125.3.44:443 in the last hour.
maya: containment: I'll remove public access and revoke SAS now.
maya: run:
```
az storage container set-permission --account-name rw-infer-logs --name ci-artifacts-prod --public-access off
az storage account keys renew --account-name rw-infer-logs --key primary
az storage container policy delete --account-name rw-infer-logs --container-name ci-artifacts-prod --name ci-sas
```
maya: done. regenerated keys and removed public access. Also deleted the pipeline secret `CI_ARTIFACT_SAS` from the repo.
jonathan: rotate SPs that can create SAS: `ci-runner-sp`, `terraform-ci-sp`. I'll start rotation for terraform sp.
vijay: NSG rule removed, replaced with allow from subnet `svc-logging` only. pushed terraform change to remove wide rule and added guard clause.
kira: collecting forensics: please snapshot `prod-logging-vm` disk and capture packet capture for 01:50-03:10 UTC. also export storage access logs to `sec-archive/1956123456` with locked ACL.
sec-bot: label:update severity=high; vector=sas-leak; action=containment-complete
olivia: legal and compliance notified. drafting external notification template in case PII exfil confirmed.
maya: found three GETs to artifacts blob from 34.125.3.44 at 02:12:10 UTC, 02:13:05 UTC, 02:13:46 UTC. saving log export to secure bucket.
jonathan: adding short-term mitigations: azpolicy to deny public containers, block long-lived SAS via policy, prevent printing of secrets in CI.
vijay: medium-term: terraform pre-commit hooks to scan for NSG rules wide-open, add CI lint to scrub logs for SAS patterns.
olivia: owners: maya -> storage rotation + policy; vijay -> NSG guardrails; jonathan -> CI secret hygiene; kira -> SOC coordination + forensics.
maya: scheduling 60m postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. will post invite and agenda.
jonathan: good job. closing containment phase. moving to investigation.
